name: WBench
summary: 评测交互式视频世界模型多轮动作响应、视觉质量和长期一致性的综合基准。
summaryEn: A comprehensive multi-turn benchmark for evaluating action response, visual quality, and long-horizon consistency in interactive video world models.
scale: Multi-turn interactive cases with released data and evaluation weights
scaleZh: 多轮交互案例，并发布数据和评测权重
accessZh: 数据集已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 针对多轮交互视频世界模型的动作条件综合评测
verdictEn: Comprehensive action-conditioned evaluation for multi-turn interactive video world models
wmNote: 多轮设定比单段视频指标更能检验误差累积和状态持久性。
wmNoteEn: Multi-turn evaluation exposes error accumulation and state persistence beyond single-clip metrics.
